description: jev-core: the two places core-claude already spends a model judgment, answered by Jev instead of a `claude -p` subprocess. PreToolUse: jev-intent-gate on Bash/Edit/Write (and the skyline equivalents) — a regex pre-match on pinned dependency installs and manifest edits, then ONE Jev request; every other tool call exits before any network. Stop: jev-research-nudge — a regex hedge gate, then ONE Jev request; silent in org sessions. Both fail open: no key, timeout, or an unparseable reply allows and logs one stderr line. If core-claude is installed beside this plugin, disable its deps.* rules and its research-nudge in the overlays so a judgment is not made twice (see README).
